Executive compensation bands for the current fiscal year: VP-level total compensation ranges from 280,000 to 420,000 including base, bonus target, and equity grant value. SVP-level ranges from 400,000 to 650,000. C-level compensation is set individually by the board compensation committee.

Equity grants vest over four years with a one-year cliff, consistent with the standard company equity plan. This document is strictly confidential and must not be shared outside the executive team.
